recovery_policy.generated_actions: Reuse the MR10D7 generated Ability action pipeline. Ability-generated actions spend no PP, do not consume the selected turn, retain normal targeting/redirection/accuracy/type/immunity/Protect/move-script flow, and may not recursively create another Ability-generated action.
recovery_policy.failure_policy: A blocker in one family must not stop independent families. Record the exact missing dependency and continue.

known_donor_recovery.Amplifier: Sound-based moves target all opposing Pokemon and deal 30 percent more damage.
known_donor_recovery.Riptide: Water-type moves deal 30 percent more damage normally and 80 percent more damage at or below one-third max HP; the low-HP value replaces the normal boost.
known_donor_recovery.Hubris: Raise Special Attack by one stage when the user directly KOs an opponent.
known_donor_recovery.Multi-Headed: Extra strikes depend on head count. Donor documentation: two heads = first hit 100 percent plus second hit 25 percent; three heads = 100 percent plus 20 percent plus 15 percent. Secondary effects roll independently except flinch. Recover the exact species/head mapping before species-specific wiring.
known_donor_recovery.Craving: End-turn pool: Sitrus, Liechi, Ganlon, Salac, Petaya, Apicot, Lansat, Starf, or a random pinch-healing berry. Mercury approval additionally requires no activation on the entry turn.
known_donor_recovery.Toxic Terrain: Donor terrain lasts 8 turns, boosts Poison-type moves, and deals 1/16 max HP at turn end to grounded non-Poison Pokemon; standard terrain replacement/lifecycle applies unless Mercury data overrides it.
known_donor_recovery.Blood Stain: Holder gains an unremovable Bleed state if not immune and re-applies it if cured; offensive or defensive qualifying contact spreads Bleed. Donor Bleed: 1/16 max HP per turn, prevents healing, negates effects of stat stages, and Rock/Ghost types are immune. Mercury's approved text controls if any local rule differs.
known_donor_recovery.DNA Scramble: Deoxys changes before move execution: damaging move -> Attack Forme; Recover -> Defense Forme; any other status move -> Speed Forme.
known_donor_recovery.Locust Swarm / Revelation: Use Mercury-approved threshold direction: transformed form while above 1/4 max HP, revert at or below 1/4. Donor naming confirms Hivemind and Revelation form keys.
